goal: Consume server-owned Journal soft-delete tombstones in the durable repository so a second client removes the entry and cancels stale outbox work only after acknowledged local persistence.
successCriteria: Authenticated own-user read includes tombstone metadata; never map deleted content to visible entries.
Remote tombstone merges durably hide matching entries and cancel stale mutations; late ACK/error cannot resurrect or poison the superseded state.
Disk failure keeps the previously acknowledged state and explicitly shows sync failure; no live two-client acceptance claimed.
untouchedSurfaces: No schema, provider, RLS, deployment or live delete.
Journal draft files belong to separate R08 agent; no edits there.

impact.entryPoint: Authenticated Journal history refresh/merge and offline outbox.
impact.dataWrite: Account-scoped envelope ACK before applying remote tombstones; no live data mutation in task.
impact.backendContract: Existing GET owner filter includes deleted_at rows as tombstone metadata; additive read contract, no query outside account.
impact.privacySafety: Deleted rows excluded from visible entries/export; tombstone IDs only, verified own-user SDK read.
impact.observability: Superseded old network failure does not mark current final state failed.
impact.rollback: Retain tombstones/envelope; old-app read filtering remains compatibility concern, no deletion of envelope.

canonicalContracts: Existing journal mobile contract unique(user_id,local_id), deleted_at and RLS remain unchanged.
Soft tombstones are delivered to authenticated own-user reads and hidden from UI/export after local ACK; cloud deletion and atomic CAS remain separate.

securityReview.authzRls: Existing explicit user_id/session/abort reads; only metadata of authenticated own deleted rows enters envelope.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Synthetic bounded journal fixtures; no private/live data.
securityReview.secretsLogging: Generic errors; no credentials or input content logging.
securityReview.externalInput: Validate tombstone ID list; remote deleted content never displayed/exported.
securityReview.dependencies: Existing pinned Supabase createClient and Deno2.9 installed; pure test handler no remote imports.
securityReview.migrationRelease: Foreign MCY staging remains blocked; no deploy/db apply.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop live action or fakeACK; record missing cross-client broadcast/atomic revision gate.

workingTreeReview.note: Root owns App/backend/repository, already dirty from R07; do not revert owner or agent work.

managerTestPath: After approved deployment, clientA delete -> clientB refresh removes same localId; simulate stale B edit/ACK, restart and disk failure with fixtures.
residualRisk: GET has no server pagination/CAS; actual two-client RLS/deployment/native gate remains. Tombstoned late write may retain private fields until retention reviewed.
nativeDeliveryReview: Installed Expo Sharing Android resolves on chooser ActivityResult, which does not prove recipient finished reading. iOS removes after sheet; Android retains only app-private named export for 10 minutes, schedules deletion and startup cleanup; no unrelated files scanned/deleted. Native receiver/device verification remains separate.
